summary_1line: The mutilated Shurpanakha confronts Ravana, rebuking his indulgence and warning that his negligent kingship invites disaster.

image_candidates.scene_text: Mutilated Shurpanakha, face disfigured and furious, stands trembling before Ravana seated on a jeweled throne amid demon counselors.
Ravana, radiant in celestial garlands and royal ornaments, glares with flame-like eyes as Shurpanakha displays her mutilated face.
